from Grace |quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Battlemage's Cry''' is a [[warcry]] [[skill]] that [[taunt]]s nearby enemies, grants the user and allies a [[critical strike]] chance [[buff]] that scales with nearby enemies, and [[exert]]s a number of subsequent melee attacks to trigger a supported [[spell]]. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''Power''': {{c|help|Normal Monsters have 1 Power, Magic Monsters 2, Rare Monsters 10, Unique Monsters 20, and Players 5}} * The [[Exert]] mechanic is not compatible with skills which repeat, therefore Battlemage's cry cannot trigger spells from attacks supported by [[Multistrike]] * An exert charge is expended when a melee attack is first initiated, even if the attack is interrupted, or does not hit anything. * Melee attacks with non-melee components, such as [[Smite]]'s lightning bolts, may potentially kill all available targets before the melee damage can land, preventing the melee hit that would trigger a spell. * When linked with multiple spells, each exerted attack will cast one spell, alternating spells in a predetermined order. The order is only progressed when a spell triggers; an exerted attack that hits no enemies will not cause the next spell in sequence to be skipped. If a spell is on cooldown when it would trigger, the next spell in sequence will trigger instead. For the infobox of the gem text and mods for the support part of the gem, see [[Battlemage's Cry Support]]. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Warcry
